dedupe_keys.name: knomad world bank bilateral remittance matrix

description: Estimates of remittance flows between every pair of countries. The World Bank blog post says KNOMAD and the World Bank released new bilateral remittance estimates for 2021, computed with the method of Ratha and Shaw (2007): inward remittances to a country are allocated to source countries in proportion to migrant stocks and per capita incomes, using 2021 flows from Migration and Development Brief 37 and a bilateral migration matrix based on UN DESA, Eurostat, national offices, UNHCR and OECD data. Top corridors named include the United States to Mexico at 52 billion US dollars. The matrix is a free download linked from the post. Coverage is global, country to country. Caveats: flows are modelled estimates, not recorded transactions. For simulation it gives the size of cross-border household money flows that payment outages, sanctions or disasters in sending countries can interrupt. A related catalogue record is the World Bank Global Findex database.
